subject: PCL: get_global callback fails ("form compiled with errors") — new pclxs t/98-globals.t skips PCL entirely
description: DONE (PCL d5b7125). Two bugs stacked: (1) `(declare (ignorable create))` inside with-xs-guard — the guard wraps its body in PROGN and a declaration in a progn is a compile-time ERROR, so SBCL signalled at first call and the guard turned it into 0; (2) underneath, GV_ADD must vivify the stash as well as the variable, and p-xs-global-symbol only did find-package. 12/12 of pclxs t/98-globals.t pass through PCL now.
